title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Interface Contract

comment.value: Physical CM5-CARRIER root; nested detailed pages form one connected board netlist
Fan 1 intake, fan 2 exhaust; independent PWM/tach channels
Program audio crosses a buffered differential TDM link
Global labels are intentional inter-page nets; prototype qualification gates remain

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Exact CM5 Connector Allocation

comment.value: Three DF40C-100DS mates; pad geometry and relative placement come from Radxa IO V2.20
76 contacts are owned: 74 connected and 2 assigned no-connect; all other functions are no-connect
U33-A includes the four official grounded CM5 mounting pads; allocated GPIO domain is 3.3 V
DETAILED CAPTURE BASELINE - verify CM5 voltage limits before release

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - PCIe / Ethernet / Wi-Fi

comment.value: PI7C9X2G608GP in 606 mode: x1 upstream plus five x1 downstream ports
Native WAN1 plus three LAN7430 endpoints use exact Wurth 74991114412 MagJacks
Exact package balls/pins from Diodes DS40210 Rev 8 and Microchip DS00002631G
Port 5 is disabled and unrouted; generic cable headers are prohibited on PCIe Gen2 lanes

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - WWAN and Dual SIM

comment.value: M.2 B-key modem socket supports USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 fallback
Dedicated 3.8 V / 6 A rail; verify selected modem peak-current waveform
FSA2567 defaults to physical SIM 1; open-drain low selects physical SIM 2
RF coax leaves the module directly for four right-side bulkhead antennas

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Lid Display Harness

comment.value: 15.6-inch lid monitor: HDMI video, USB 2 touch, 12 V / 2.5 A
Carrier connectors face downward at the hinge-edge harness notch
USB-A is the CM5 host end; cable terminates in USB-B SuperSpeed at the monitor
No display eFuse; separate fused DISPLAY_12V and DISPLAY_IO_12V branches feed this sheet

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - TDM and Headset Audio

comment.value: I2S0/TDM program audio is buffered over LVDS to the separate AUDIO-8X8 board
I2S1 uses explicit 3.3 V to 1.8 V translation before the ES8316 codec
TPA6132A2 provides 0 dB dedicated stereo headphone amplification
Kycon STX-353K7A is CTIA-mapped; its preliminary land pattern requires a coupon

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Power Regulators and Sequencing

comment.value: RAW_OUT_LOAD accepts 10.5 V to 30 V after source selection and load telemetry
The 27.2 mF / 50 V no-blink bank resides on floor-mounted PWR-SELECT
DISPLAY_12V is a fused 12 V / 2.5 A harness branch with no dedicated eFuse
Component values are Rev A1 starting values; bench loop, thermal, and transfer validation remain mandatory

title_block.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm Carrier - Thermal and GPIO Control

comment.value: EMC2305 controls CPU, modem, intake, and exhaust fans independently
PWM pull-ups provide full-speed hardware fallback if the controller or firmware fails
TMP117 sensors monitor CM5, modem, and board/power zones at 0x48/0x49/0x4A
TCA9535 devices at 0x20/0x21/0x22 capture status and drive safe control outputs
Two 12 V diffused warm-white panel lamps use an independent latching capacitive touch switch
